skill.name: x402
skill.description: Build and inspect x402 payment requests for USDC on Base. Create unsigned EIP-3009 payloads, X-PAYMENT headers, facilitator calls, and server payment requirements.
skill.summary: Prepare, inspect, verify, and settle custody-free x402 payments for API access.
skill.author: internet-court

security_audit.summary: All 19 static findings are false positives caused by Markdown code spans and descriptions of URL fetching. One medium semantic risk remains because the workflow prepares and submits user-approved USDC payment authorizations. No prompt injection or credential-custody behavior was found.

remediation.issue: The workflow can submit a signed authorization that transfers USDC.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit confirmation of amount, asset, network, recipient, and expiry before signing or settlement. Use testnet and small values during validation.

semantic_findings.title: User-Approved Cryptocurrency Transfer
semantic_findings.description: The workflow builds an EIP-3009 authorization, accepts a wallet signature, submits an X-PAYMENT header, and supports facilitator settlement. Incorrect approval can transfer USDC to an unintended recipient.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The documented client and server flows explicitly prepare signed payment headers and settle incoming payments. Wallet signing limits custody risk but does not remove financial loss risk.

content.value_statement: Paying or monetizing x402 endpoints requires precise payment data and protocol steps. This skill decodes requirements, prepares unsigned authorizations, and supports verification and settlement.
actual_capabilities: Decode x402 challenges and X-PAYMENT headers into amount, token, recipient, and expiry details.
Build unsigned EIP-3009 typed data from payment requirements.
Assemble an X-PAYMENT header after a wallet produces a signature.
Query facilitator supported, verify, and settle operations.
Fetch x402 resources and continue paid requests with a supplied payment header.
Generate server payment requirements for USDC endpoints on Base or Base Sepolia.
limitations: Requires compatible ChainGPT x402 tools and an external wallet for signatures.
Does not hold private keys or sign payment authorizations.
The documented known token defaults cover USDC on Base and Base Sepolia.
Payments and settlement can have irreversible financial consequences.

prompt_templates.title: Decode a payment request
prompt_templates.prompt: Decode this x402 challenge. List the amount, token, recipient, network, and expiry. Do not build payment data yet: [challenge].

prompt_templates.title: Prepare an unsigned payment
prompt_templates.prompt: Create unsigned EIP-3009 typed data for these requirements and payer: [requirements] [payer]. Highlight every field that needs verification before signing.
prompt_templates.scenario: Prepare a payment for wallet review

prompt_templates.title: Complete a paid request
prompt_templates.prompt: Guide the x402 flow for [URL] using payer [address]. Stop before signing, then continue only after I provide an approved signature.
prompt_templates.scenario: Run a controlled client payment flow

prompt_templates.title: Monetize and settle an endpoint
prompt_templates.prompt: Create payment requirements for [amount] USDC on [network] to [recipient]. Outline challenge delivery, facilitator verification, settlement, and failure handling.
prompt_templates.scenario: Design an advanced server payment flow

best_practices: Inspect the amount, recipient, asset, network, nonce, and expiry before signing.
Require explicit human approval before signature or settlement.
Test with Base Sepolia and small values before production.
anti_patterns: Never expose private keys or seed phrases to the skill or facilitator.
Do not sign opaque typed data without matching it to decoded requirements.
Do not reuse signatures, ignore expiry, or send payment headers to unrelated URLs.

faq.question: Does this skill hold my private key?
faq.answer: No. It prepares unsigned typed data and requires an external wallet to produce the signature.

faq.question: Which networks are documented?
faq.answer: The skill documents Base and Base Sepolia for known EIP-3009 USDC usage.

faq.question: Can it pay an x402-protected API?
faq.answer: Yes. It can decode the challenge, prepare payment data, assemble the header, and retry after wallet approval.

faq.question: Can it monetize my API?
faq.answer: Yes. It can generate payment requirements and support facilitator verification and settlement.

faq.question: Does it sign transactions automatically?
faq.answer: No. Signing happens in the payer wallet, outside the skill.

faq.question: What should I verify before signing?
faq.answer: Verify the amount, asset, network, recipient, nonce, expiry, and the resource receiving the payment header.
